description.value: Wilson Creek UBrew is the Sunshine Coast's longest-running Brew on Premise facility, established in 1993 and located in Wilson Creek halfway between Gibsons and Sechelt. Customers select and brew wine kits, craft beers, ciders, and hard seltzers in a purpose-built on-site facility, then return to bottle and take their finished beverages home. The business also offers an in-house cider line made from Okanagan apple juice and nine all-natural hard seltzer flavours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website makes clear this is a Brew on Premise (BOP) facility where customers brew their own wines, beers, ciders, and hard seltzers across multiple planned sessions — not a taproom, café, or any stop where a touring cyclist can obtain immediate refreshment or services. The website corroborates the OSM address (adding suite #102, city Sechelt, and postal code V7Z 0B1) and provides a phone number absent from OSM, but mentions no cycling-specific amenities anywhere. Because the business model requires advance booking and multi-week production cycles, it does not function as a viable cyclist waypoint.
